intelligence.enrichment: Most rocks are mixtures of minerals; most minerals are compounds made of more than one element, while some native minerals are pure elements and not compounds. The composition of the rock or mineral determines whether it is classified as a mixture, a compound, or a pure element. The learner correctly applies this rule: Most rocks are mixtures of minerals; most minerals are compounds made of more than one element, while some native minerals are pure elements and not compounds. Every mineral is a compound, so a mineral cannot be a pure element.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Elements, compounds and mixtures. The student must decide: Classify rocks and minerals by deciding whether the material is a mixture of minerals, a compound mineral, or a native mineral that is a pure element. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key.
